‘HANDS OFF OUR TREES’

Trees along Quirino Avenue in Manila are being cut down to make way for the SALEx project, with hundreds already removed under a DENR permit. Environmental groups staged a protest on May 26, warning of worsening heat and flooding risks in the city.
